data.title: Binghatti Royale
data.about:
Binghatti Royal is an upcoming project by the master developer in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Inspired by contemporary and harmonious design concepts, this residential masterpiece offers an exclusive lifestyle crafted to meet the highest standards of luxury living. The apartments for sale in Binghatti Royale are available in 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations.

With major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road just minutes away, commuting to Dubai's key business and leisure hubs is seamless. Binghatti Royal also offers an array of amenities that cater to every aspect of modern living. From a state-of-the-art fitness center and rooftop swimming pool with panoramic views to beautifully landscaped gardens and high-end retail outlets on the ground floor, every element of Binghatti Royal is designed to enhance the lifestyle of its residents.

characteristics_module.title: Stunning Exterior, Modern Interior, Perfectly Aligned with Nature
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Striking, angular façade combining classical and contemporary design.
  • Luxurious interiors with premium materials like oak wood and calacatta oro.
  • Prime location in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) with seamless connectivity.
  • High-end features & amenities in Binghatti Royale include a rooftop infinity pool, outdoor gym, and juice bar.
  • Family-friendly environment with access to parks, trails, and schools.
  • Ground-floor retail outlets for convenient shopping and dining.
  • Its proximity to major highways and key areas of Dubai ensures easy access to the city’s business districts, shopping centers, and leisure attractions.
  • A project of the Binghatti Group, renowned for innovative architecture and distinctive design.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Peaceful Living in a Family-friendly Community
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a thriving residential community located in the heart of new Dubai, offering a unique blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility. Its prime location ensures that residents are never far from the city’s bustling business districts, world-class shopping centers, and renowned leisure attractions. 

With major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road providing seamless connectivity, JVC is ideally positioned for easy access to all corners of Dubai, making daily commutes and weekend adventures a breeze.

Dubai Hills Mall - 6 Minutes
Dubai Sports City - 8 Minutes
Circle Mall - 9 Minutes
Dubai Internet City - 10 Minutes
Jumeirah Village Triangle - 10 Minutes
Dubai Miracle Garden - 13 Minutes
City Centre Meaisem - 13 Minutes
